title: Routes, Balance, Weight, Springs & Popovers
description: A scroll-driven SVG map flythrough, the soon-to-ship flex-wrap: balance, faked variable-font choreography, real spring-physics magnets, and a Popover API combobox.

drops.title: Route Flythrough
drops.description: A scroll-driven SVG route where the camera pans, zooms, and reveals waypoints as your scroll position advances — no map API needed.
drops.concept: Reimplements the mechanics behind Codrops' scroll-driven SVG map tutorials without GSAP's DrawSVG/MotionPath plugins: raw SVGPathElement.getTotalLength()/getPointAtLength() drive stroke-dashoffset draw-on, a moving vehicle marker, and an inverse-translated camera group that keeps the current point centered while easing zoom in and out across the journey. Four waypoints fade in with labels and a live checklist as you pass them.
drops.source: Inspired by Tom Miller's 'Creating Scroll-Driven SVG Map Animations with GSAP' — Codrops, May 2026

interaction.mouse: Scroll to advance the flight along the route
interaction.click: Switch camera style / theme in the debug panel
interaction.touch: Scroll works identically on touch devices

drops.title: Balanced Rows
drops.description: A live preview of the upcoming flex-wrap: balance CSS value across a tag cloud, photo strip, and pricing cards — redistributes items so every line is close to the same width.
drops.concept: flex-wrap: balance is headed to browsers (Intent to Ship, May 2026) but isn't reliably supported yet, so this demo runs an equivalent JS algorithm: determine the line count a normal wrap would produce, then binary-search the minimal max-line-width threshold and greedily pack items into that many balanced lines — the same idea as minimizing ragged-line variance that text-wrap: balance popularized for text.
drops.source: Inspired by the CSS Working Group's flex-wrap: balance Intent to Ship discussion

interaction.mouse: Toggle wrap vs balance per panel, drag width slider to resize
interaction.click: Toggle buttons switch layout mode instantly

drops.title: Weight Choreography
drops.description: Proximity-mapped weight swells, hover weight/slant/casual-axis rows, and an ambient breathing headline — variable-font choreography without loading a variable font.
drops.concept: CodeFronts' variable-font demos use Recursive's wght/slnt/CASL axes via font-variation-settings. Since this page can't load external fonts, the same expressive feel is faked with the classic crossfaded-weight-layers trick: a regular-weight and a bold-weight copy of each letter are stacked, and their opacity is driven by cursor proximity, hover state, or a sine-wave 'breathing' loop.
drops.source: Inspired by CodeFronts' '30 CSS Text Animations' (variable-font choreography demos)

interaction.mouse: Move cursor near the headline to swell nearby letters; hover nav rows
interaction.touch: Touchmove drives the proximity effect on mobile

drops.title: Spring Magnets
drops.description: Five magnetic buttons driven by real per-frame damped harmonic oscillators, not CSS transitions — tune stiffness, damping, mass, and pull radius live.
drops.concept: Most magnetic-button demos reverse-engineer a spring feel from an easing curve. This one implements the actual physics: each button integrates F = −k·x − c·v every animation frame via semi-implicit Euler, so stiffness (k), damping (c), and mass (m) are genuine simulation parameters you can drag live, with Snappy/Bouncy/Gentle presets swapping k/c pairs instantly.
drops.source: Inspired by SmoothUI's 'Building a Magnetic Button with Cursor Physics'

interaction.mouse: Hover near any button to feel the pull; move away to watch it spring back
interaction.click: Buttons are fully clickable and show a toast
interaction.touch: Pointer events cover touch, though the radius falloff is most visible with a mouse

drops.title: Popover Combobox
drops.description: Three searchable comboboxes — country picker, command palette, and tag adder — all built on the native Popover API for automatic light-dismiss and top-layer stacking.
drops.concept: Instead of a manually z-indexed, manually dismissed floating div, the option listbox is a real popover element (popover="auto"), giving free light-dismiss and top-layer rendering. A hand-rolled combobox controller adds live filtering, full ARIA combobox/listbox roles with aria-activedescendant, and keyboard nav (arrows, Home/End, Enter, Escape) on top, with a JS fallback for browsers without Popover support.
drops.source: Inspired by Maquina Components 0.3.0 'Combobox and Toast' release notes

interaction.mouse: Click a trigger to open, click an option to select
interaction.click: Keyboard arrows navigate, Enter selects, Escape dismisses
interaction.touch: Inputs and options are touch-sized and tappable
